name: Ring of Swimming (improved)
source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 175, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 479
body:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 175, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 479
Aura moderate transmutation CL 7th
Slot ring; Price 10,000 gp; Weight —
Description
As a ring of swimming, except it grants a +10 competence bonus on its wearer’s Swim checks.
Construction
Requirements Forge Ring, creator must have 10 ranks in Swim; Cost 5,000 gp
